# AI Blocks

> Free AI skills, workflows, prompts and minds for real work. Each skill is a reusable SKILL.md for an AI assistant that can read files.

## Connect your AI

- MCP server (public, no sign-in): https://useaiblocks.com/mcp
- Server card: [https://useaiblocks.com/mcp/server-card](https://useaiblocks.com/mcp/server-card), listed in [/.well-known/ai-catalog.json](https://useaiblocks.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json)
- REST API: [OpenAPI description](https://useaiblocks.com/api/v1/openapi.json). Search with https://useaiblocks.com/api/v1/search?q=ad+angles, read one item with https://useaiblocks.com/api/v1/items/ad-angle-planner
- Setup guide for ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code and Codex: [Connect your AI](https://useaiblocks.com/api-and-mcp)
- For a whole business goal, an owner pastes one message into their AI, which calls start_outcome: [Get a whole job done](https://useaiblocks.com/get-it-done), with a [worked example](https://useaiblocks.com/get-it-done/example) and a [job status page](https://useaiblocks.com/get-it-done/status)
- Every item page has a Markdown version and a JSON version: [/skills/ad-angle-planner.md](https://useaiblocks.com/skills/ad-angle-planner.md) and [.json](https://useaiblocks.com/skills/ad-angle-planner.json), linked from each page's head.
- New and changed items: [JSON Feed](https://useaiblocks.com/feed.json) and [RSS](https://useaiblocks.com/feed.xml), plus lastmod dates in the [sitemap](https://useaiblocks.com/sitemap.xml)

Once connected, ask in plain words:

- "Use AI Blocks to get ad-angle-planner."
- "Use AI Blocks to find a skill that writes ad angles."
- "Use AI Blocks to plan a workflow for my weekly report."
- "Use AI Blocks to show what's new this week."

## Key facts

- Browsing, catalogue downloads and manual workflow assembly are free, with no account needed. AI workflow planning requires sign-in and follows the current service limits.
- 5032 skills, workflows and prompts in 70 jobs, 1064 specialists, 505 minds and 68 mini tools.
- Imported skills keep their open-licence sources and credits (MIT, Apache 2.0, BSD, CC BY, CC BY-SA). Local changes are identified on the page and in the skill file.
- Minds are AIs built from a person's public work, with their sources listed. They are not the person. Minds that invest teach frameworks only, never buy or sell advice.
- Skills that scrape websites or need a paid outside account say so on their page.
- Last changed 2026-11-09. See the [JSON Feed](https://useaiblocks.com/feed.json) or [RSS](https://useaiblocks.com/feed.xml) for what changed.

## Planning and privacy

- Use search to find relevant skills. A skill page shows what to prepare before it and what can use its result next. Add the steps you need to the builder.
- When planning with your AI, keep the original request and use relevant supplied context, including me.md when available. Read the chosen methods and supporting files. Give each step a clear task, required material, expected result and checks.
- Public API and MCP workflow tools return plans and instructions. They do not run skills or make model calls on your behalf. Your AI runs the work with its own tools and credits. The signed-in website planner uses the AI Blocks service.
- Saved personal and company workflows require their connected account and access checks. Never put credentials or private workflow links in public searches. A prepared plan is not approval to send, spend or publish.

## How to use a skill

- Every skill has a page and a skill file. For example: [Ad angle planner](https://useaiblocks.com/skills/ad-angle-planner), and its file [SKILL.md](https://useaiblocks.com/skills/ad-angle-planner/SKILL.md). Add the file to your AI as a skill, or paste it into a chat.
- [Every page by job](https://useaiblocks.com/jobs), and the whole catalogue as data: [blocks.json](https://useaiblocks.com/data/blocks.json)

## Main pages

- [Plan an AI team](https://useaiblocks.com/teams): review outcome-first specialist plans, input/output handoffs and permissions. On MCP, start_outcome is the front door for any business goal. The REST routes /api/v1/request-scopes, /api/v1/scoped-work-preparations and /api/v1/recommendation-handoffs turn evidence-backed chosen recommendations into work for the next orchestrator. Work and artifacts remain in the user's AI and authorized local project by default. POST /api/v1/specialist-team-preparations and /api/v1/specialist-team-checkpoints (prepare_specialist_team and checkpoint_specialist_team on signed-in connections) validate current sources and host-reported checkpoints; authenticated personal/company connections support explicit workflow saves, scoped memory and reviewed revocable sharing. No public hosted execution.
- [Workflow planner](https://useaiblocks.com/compose): describe a task, review a plan and download it for your AI
- [Hire an AI specialist](https://useaiblocks.com/roles): choose a job role, its deliverables and methods, then prepare a complete role pack. MCP tools find_specialist and prepare_specialist choose and onboard a worker for a task. Read aiblocks://roles/{id} for SOUL.md, knowledge, playbook, method routing, connection requirements, editable training/context and permission boundaries. API: GET /api/v1/specialists?task=... and POST /api/v1/specialist-preparations. Execution happens in the user’s AI.
- [Your me.md](https://useaiblocks.com/me-md): prepare reusable context for your AI
- [Train your own AI agent](https://useaiblocks.com/train-your-own-ai-agent): a step-by-step guide and starter pack for teaching your AI one job your way

  - [AI customer service: faster replies built on your own policies](https://useaiblocks.com/blog/ai-customer-support-replies): Set up AI customer service the safe way. Build a reply library from your policies, draft replies in your tone and know when a person must answer.
  - [AI meeting notes: turn any meeting into clear action items](https://useaiblocks.com/blog/ai-meeting-notes-action-items): Turn rough notes or a transcript into AI meeting notes: decisions, owners, dates and open questions. Includes prompts, a template and a checklist.
  - [AI product photography that still looks like your product](https://useaiblocks.com/blog/ai-product-photos): Make AI product photography from real photos of your real product. Get a shot list, scene prompts, checks before you publish and honest ad rules.
  - [AI prompts vs skills vs workflows: which one to use](https://useaiblocks.com/blog/ai-prompts-vs-skills-vs-workflows): AI prompts vs skills, workflows, agents and specialists in plain words, with a decision table, a real example and prompts to pick the right one.
  - [How to put a team of AI experts on one job](https://useaiblocks.com/blog/ai-team-of-experts): Treat your AI like a team, not one assistant. Pick specialists with different methods, give each a seat, keep them apart and have an outsider check the work.
  - [How to analyze data with ChatGPT and check the numbers](https://useaiblocks.com/blog/analyse-spreadsheet-with-ai): Analyze data with ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. Prepare the file, ask clear questions, make the AI show its working and check every number before you act.

  - [How to write ChatGPT prompts that get usable work](https://useaiblocks.com/blog/chatgpt-prompts-for-work): How to write ChatGPT prompts that give usable work: six parts, before-and-after examples, a reusable template and tips for Claude and Gemini too.

  - [Write Facebook ad copy with AI that people believe](https://useaiblocks.com/blog/facebook-ad-copy-with-ai): Write Facebook ad copy with AI from real product facts and buyer words. Get the job of each ad part, hook styles, Meta's rules and prompts to copy.
  - [AI search optimization: get your business found and cited](https://useaiblocks.com/blog/get-found-in-ai-search): AI search optimization in plain steps: how ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews pick sources, and what to fix so your pages get found and cited.
  - [How to get real variety from AI, not 20 of the same](https://useaiblocks.com/blog/get-variety-from-ai): Why AI repeats itself, and how to get options that really differ: list the kinds first, pick a mix, use one maker per kind, then run a sameness check.
  - [ChatGPT custom instructions for business that end generic answers](https://useaiblocks.com/blog/give-ai-context-about-your-business): Set up ChatGPT custom instructions for business, plus projects in ChatGPT and Claude and Gems in Gemini, with a one-page brand file template and prompts.
  - [Google Ads AI: write better ads and stop paying for junk searches](https://useaiblocks.com/blog/google-ads-with-ai): Use Google Ads AI help from your own assistant: write responsive search ads within the limits, find wasted spend and build negative keyword lists.
